title.purpose: Shared settings, export and recent-project headings.

motion.name: resize-affordance

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Shared action for export dialogs, memory and connection recovery.
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .12s,color .12s,border-color .12s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:32px;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:4px;background:#45cfc1;color:#102f2b;font-weight:600;border:1px solid #45cfc1}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#70e1d4;border-color:#70e1d4}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#37d7cb);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Subordinate dialog action with a slate fill and fine border.
components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .12s,color .12s,border-color .12s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;min-height:32px;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:4px;background:#303a47;color:#d0dceb;border:1px solid #4a5a70}.ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#34383f}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#37d7cb);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Text field
components.description: Shared graphite field with cyan caret and focus outline.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" aria-label="프로젝트 이름" value="잠시, 멈추는 여행" />
components.css: .ds-input{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--text,#f0f2f5);background:#292c31;border:1px solid #41464f;border-radius:4px;padding:7px 9px;caret-color:var(--accent,#37d7cb);outline:none}.ds-input:focus{border-color:#47b6ae}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#37d7cb);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-input::placeholder{color:#a0a7b3;opacity:1}

components.name: Library navigation
components.description: Fixed-size category controls with active cyan labels and horizontal overflow.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="편집 소재"><button class="ds-nav-item ds-nav-active" aria-current="page"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="20" height="20" x="2" y="2" rx="2.18" ry="2.18"/><path d="M7 2v20M17 2v20M2 12h20M2 7h5M2 17h5M17 17h5M17 7h5"/></svg>미디어</button><button class="ds-nav-item"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 18V5l12-2v13"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="16" r="3"/></svg>오디오</button><button class="ds-nav-item"><svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 7V4h16v3M9 20h6M12 4v16"/></svg>텍스트</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:2px;padding:9px 8px 7px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,#34373c);background:var(--panel,#1c1e21);overflow-x:auto}.ds-nav-item{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .12s,color .12s,border-color .12s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;flex-shrink:0;min-width:49px;gap:5px;padding:4px 5px;color:var(--muted,#a7adb7);font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap;background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:4px}.ds-nav-item:hover{color:var(--text,#f0f2f5);background:#282b30}.ds-nav-item.ds-nav-active{color:var(--accent,#37d7cb)}.ds-nav-item:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#37d7cb);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Selected context chip
components.description: Current assistant context; the shipped 9px label is recorded as a legibility limitation, not a new reading-size token.

components.name: Audio media tile
components.description: Media library tile with an inline SVG illustration, filename and add affordance.
components.css: .ds-media{min-width:0;margin:0;width:150px;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif}.ds-thumb{aspect-ratio:1.55;background:#2b2e34;border-radius:4px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #41454e;cursor:grab}.ds-thumb:hover{border-color:var(--accent,#37d7cb)}.ds-audio{height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#9bc6dd;background:#26323f}.ds-add{transition:background-color .12s,color .12s,border-color .12s;position:absolute;bottom:4px;right:4px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:#34383ed9;padding:3px;color:#fff;cursor:pointer}.ds-add:hover{background:var(--accent,#37d7cb);color:#122323}.ds-add:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#37d7cb);outline-offset:2px}.ds-media>p{overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5;color:#c5cad2;margin:6px 0 0}

components.css: .ds-dialog{font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif;line-height:1.5;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:min(640px,100%);background:#222831;border:1px solid #4b5667;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 20px 65px #0008;overflow:hidden}.ds-dialog>header{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:20px 23px 17px;border-bottom:1px solid #3a4555}.ds-dialog h2{font-size:17px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.3px;color:#ecf0f7;margin:0}.ds-dialog header>button{transition:background-color .12s,color .12s,border-color .12s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#becbdb;padding:3px;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer}.ds-dialog header>button:hover{background:#34383f}.ds-dialog header>button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#37d7cb);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-dialog>footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;border-top:1px solid #3d4a5e;padding:14px 23px;background:#202731;color:#a4b5ce;font-size:10px}

components.name: Timeline text clip
components.description: Selected text clip with visible accent trim handles; each handle is keyboard focusable and supports one-frame arrow nudges.
components.html:
잠시, 멈춰도 괜찮아
잠시, 멈춰도 괜찮아
components.css: .ds-clip{position:relative;height:40px;width:240px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid #a1895a;background:#71572f;color:#fae7bf;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans KR", sans-serif;line-height:1.5;cursor:grab;user-select:none;outline:2px solid #e0fff8;outline-offset:-1px}.ds-clip:active{cursor:grabbing}.ds-clip:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent,#37d7cb)}.ds-clip-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;min-width:0;height:19px;padding:1px 14px;background:#6b522de6;font-size:9px;white-space:nowrap}.ds-clip-label>span{flex:1;min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.ds-clip-preview{font-size:9px;padding:1px 8px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:#ead5b1}.ds-trim{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:10px;border:0;padding:0;cursor:ew-resize;opacity:1;background:var(--accent,#37d7cb)}.ds-trim-left{left:0}.ds-trim-right{right:0}.ds-clip:hover .ds-trim,.ds-clip:focus-visible .ds-trim{opacity:.8} .ds-trim:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:35%;height:30%;width:1px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#101114}.ds-trim:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #f0f2f5;outline-offset:-2px;background:#f0f2f5}

narrative.overview:
Byori Studio follows the user's pinned CapCut Desktop reference: charcoal working surfaces, restrained cyan emphasis, photographic footage and compact editing controls. The interface is a Korean desktop workspace whose visual hierarchy follows the editing task. Media and the composition carry the imagery; the surrounding chrome stays quiet.

The assistant, concept notes and memory occupy the same restrained working environment. Their slightly cooler surfaces distinguish an auxiliary workspace without introducing a separate brand. Preserve the Byori Studio name and familiar Korean editing terminology. This document records the implemented React interface in the macOS Tauri app; it does not assert complete CapCut feature parity or a mobile design.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal panels separated by narrow gutters and fine dividers.
Cyan emphasis for actions, active tools, navigation and keyboard focus.
Compact Korean controls with stable numeric readouts.
Photographic media tiles, timeline filmstrips and an actual composite preview.
A resizable timeline and an auxiliary agent, concept and memory drawer.
Expose split and trim as labeled actions; selected clip handles stay visible and keyboard accessible.

rules.name: The Action and Media Rule
rules.body: Cyan identifies interaction; muted track colors identify media types. Preserve that distinction when adding tools or tracks.

rules.name: The Stable Readout Rule
rules.body: Timecodes and numeric metadata use tabular numerals so changing values do not disturb alignment.

rules.name: The Working Plane Rule
rules.body: Working panels separate through tone and dividers; floating layers use soft shadows to make their position legible.

dos: Do preserve the Byori Studio name and Korean editing terminology.
Do use cyan for interaction and muted track colors for media classification.
Do retain visible selection and keyboard focus above rendered media.
Do keep overflow navigation reachable and timeline height adjustable.
Do use real project imagery and composite frames in editing and export previews.
Do keep new controls within the compact desktop panel, field and button language.
donts: Don't replace working-panel hierarchy with promotional display typography.
Don't add decorative shadows to ordinary media tiles or editing controls.
Don't let the rendered preview cover selection affordances.
Don't treat the demonstrated desktop layout as an implemented mobile system or full CapCut feature parity.
